has_prev.description: Flag indicating if there is a previous page. Deprecated, use `prev_page_token` instead.

has_next.description: Flag indicating if there is a next page. Deprecated, use `next_page_token` instead.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page, to be passed in subsequent requests as the `page_token` query parameter. `null` when there is no next page.

prev_page_token.description: Token to fetch the previous page, to be passed in subsequent requests as the `page_token` query parameter. `null` when there is no previous page.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction this document is attached to.

size.description: Size of the attached file in bytes.

mime_type.description: Mime type of the attached file.

date.description: Date at which the file has been attached to a transaction.

is_deleted.description: Whether or not this attachment has been deleted.
